sources.title: Project status return — Bondo Sub-County Health Centre II
sources.excerpt: Project status: Completed. Reported complete 14 March 2023. Contract sum KES 41,200,000. Implementing agency: Siaya County Department of Health.
sources.quality_notes: Status returns are self-reported by the implementing agency and are not independently inspected before publication.

sources.title: County health infrastructure — annual report extract
sources.excerpt: Three facilities reported as complete in the 2022/23 return could not be confirmed as operational at the time of audit. Final payment certificates were not availed for review.
sources.quality_notes: The extract does not name individual facilities, so the link to any one project is inferential.

sources.title: Notice of variation — county health works
sources.excerpt: Notice is given that the scope of works for Bondo Sub-County Health Centre II is varied to exclude the maternity wing, with revised completion expected in the 2025/26 financial year.
sources.quality_notes: Gazette notices are authoritative for the fact of variation but do not report physical progress.

sources.title: Residents query stalled health centre
sources.excerpt: Residents say the facility has not admitted patients since construction slowed in 2023. The county department did not respond to a request for comment.
sources.quality_notes: Single outlet, no independent corroboration of the dates given.

sources.title: Department of Health — public contact
sources.excerpt: Department of Health, Siaya County. Public enquiries: health@fixture.invalid. Postal: P.O. Box 803, Siaya.
sources.quality_notes: Office-level contact. The directory does not confirm the current holder of the post.

sources.title: Access to Information Act, 2016 — section 9
sources.excerpt: A public entity shall respond to an application for access to information within twenty-one days of receipt.
sources.quality_notes: Statutory text. Administrative practice may differ from the statutory period.
